title: Backprop explorer — how a network assigns blame

checkpoints.hint: Hit Auto Train and watch real backpropagation: the output's error becomes a blame signal (delta) that flows BACKWARD along the orange paths, and each hidden neuron gets a share of the blame scaled by how strongly it fed the output. Every weight then nudges down its own gradient. Thicker lines = bigger weights = paths that matter more. Stacking neurons like this is what lets a network bend a curved boundary a single neuron never could.
